## Step 3 — Browser exploration (source: `playwright-cli` 0.1.19, standalone on PATH)
The project-local Playwright 1.58.2 does **not** expose a `cli` subcommand (`npx --no-install playwright help cli` prints root help), so the standalone host CLI was used.

A before-dispatch `context.route('**/*')` guard was installed **before** any navigation and kept for the whole session; it allowed only `http://localhost:5174[/?]…` and aborted everything else. It demonstrably fired: the app's own requests to `fonts.googleapis.com` and `http://localhost:3001/api/messages` were aborted (console `net::ERR_FAILED`). I initiated zero off-origin navigations. Final browser URL was re-checked after every navigation.

**Preflight deviation (disclosed):** the bundled `run-preflight-target.sh` could not complete. Vite binds **only** to `::1` on this host (`curl` → `::1` = 200, `127.0.0.1` = connection refused), so the `localhost` peer set disagreed; retargeting at the literal `http://[::1]:5174/` then failed because the helper passes `--resolve ::1:5174:[::1]`, which curl rejects (exit 49) for an IP-literal host. I ran the equivalent pinned probe myself: `curl --disable --noproxy '*' --max-redirs 0 http://[::1]:5174/` → `status=200, redirect=<empty>, remote=::1:5174` — a single canonical loopback peer, no DNS step, no credentials, exact origin. Verdict: `reachable`.

Per the completion matrix this caps the result at PARTIAL/BLOCKED.
- **V6 PASS** — independent fresh-context read-only reviewer, recorded verdict above.
